title: Connection failures on billing-svc
impact: Requests failed while connections were refused on billing-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] billing-svc 2026-03-08 05:14-09:34: billing-svc: 250 of 340 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-03-08 05:14 and 2026-03-08 09:34 UTC (peak error ratio 0.93 vs baseline median 0.0). 2 error templates, 1 first seen in this span.
error_templates: c.f.b.api.UsageController - account <*> requested usage for a closed period

_templates.macro: Terraform change to the {svc} parameter group cut max_connections {old} -> {new}; after the next reboot the services' pools exceeded it and new connections were refused.
_templates.remediation: Restore max_connections = {old} on {resource} and reboot in the maintenance window.

rca.macro: Terraform change to the billing-db parameter group cut max_connections 500 -> 100; after the next reboot the services' pools exceeded it and new connections were refused.
rca.remediation: Restore max_connections = 500 on aws_db_parameter_group.billing_db and reboot in the maintenance window.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `c.f.b.repo.InvoiceRepository - call to billing-db failed: <*> <*> <*> <*> <*> <*`.
